organizingIdeas.title: Earth Systems
organizingIdeas.statement: Understandings of the living world, Earth, and space are deepened by investigating natural systems and their interactions.

outcomes.outcome: Children examine and describe surrounding environments.

knowledge.text: Environment refers to physical surroundings.
Environments include plants, humans, and other animals.
Environments include human-made structures such as buildings and roads.
Environments include land, water, and air.
Environments can be explored by using the senses.
